skill.name: skill-doctor
skill.description: Grades agent skills by scoring agent conversations against efficiency and code-quality rubrics, then drafts concrete skill edits and a shareable report. Use when the user wants their agent setup graded from real conversation history, or asks which of their installed skills are actually working.
skill.summary: Reviews local agent conversations, scores execution quality, and drafts evidence-based skill improvements with a shareable report.
skill.author: warpdotdev

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives from Markdown formatting, test fixtures, CSS, or fixed-argument git subprocesses. Confirmed capabilities include reading Claude and Codex history directories and Warp conversation databases. Semantic review found prompt-injection and scope-enforcement gaps, unredacted transcript copies, and an unvalidated report link.

remediation.issue: Transcript and installed-skill text can contain prompt injection.
remediation.suggestion: Mark all collected text as untrusted data, ignore embedded instructions, and score it without granting tools or following referenced commands.

remediation.issue: Project scope is checked after full session parsing.
remediation.suggestion: Read only minimal metadata first, reject out-of-scope sessions, and parse message content only after the scope check succeeds.

remediation.issue: Transcript artifacts can retain credentials and private content.
remediation.suggestion: Redact common secret fields before writing, disclose retention, restrict permissions, and delete the scratch directory unless the user keeps it.

remediation.issue: The report accepts arbitrary cta_url schemes.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only https URLs from an approved host list, or replace invalid values with the fixed Warp URL.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Transcript and Skill Content Enters Agent Context
semantic_findings.description: The workflow asks the agent to read historical transcripts and installed skill files without a clear untrusted-data boundary. The narrow tag filter does not cover ordinary prompt-injection prose or tool outputs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill explicitly loads transcript and skill text into the scoring workflow, while the collector filters only a short list of tag-shaped prefixes.

semantic_findings.title: Conversation Scope Is Enforced After Content Parsing
semantic_findings.description: For Claude Code and Codex, the collector parses each recent session before checking whether its working directory matches the selected projects. This reads out-of-scope conversation content into memory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The control flow calls each full session parser before the repository-scope condition, directly contradicting the user-selected project boundary.

semantic_findings.title: Transcript Copies Lack Secret Redaction and Cleanup
semantic_findings.description: The collector copies user messages, tool arguments, and tool outputs into persistent Markdown files. It truncates content but does not redact credentials or remove the scratch directory after use.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The source visibly writes condensed transcript fields to disk and contains no redaction or cleanup step.

semantic_findings.title: Report Link Scheme Is Not Validated
semantic_findings.description: The renderer escapes cta_url for HTML but accepts any URI scheme. A crafted report can place a javascript or data URL behind the visible Request access link.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: HTML escaping does not restrict URI schemes, and the value is read directly from report data before insertion into href.

content.user_title: Grade and Improve Your Agent Skills
content.value_statement: Agent skills are difficult to evaluate from configuration alone. This skill reviews local conversations, scores outcomes, and drafts evidence-based improvements.
actual_capabilities: Collects recent local conversations from Warp, Claude Code, and Codex.
Filters sessions by project, date window, skill scope, and subagent inclusion.
Builds condensed transcripts and samples sessions across detected skills.
Scores agent efficiency and code quality with included rubrics.
Drafts evidence-linked skill changes without modifying installed skill files.
Renders a self-contained HTML report with a local PNG export.
limitations: Supports only Warp, Claude Code, and Codex conversation formats.
Results depend on available local history and the selected sample.
Code quality cannot be scored when transcripts omit meaningful code changes.
Collected transcripts can contain sensitive data and require careful handling.

use_cases.title: Review Project Agent Performance
use_cases.description: Score recent project conversations and identify repeated inefficiency or code-quality failures.

use_cases.title: Audit Team Skill Adoption
use_cases.description: Measure which installed skills appear in sampled sessions and where trigger descriptions may fail.

use_cases.title: Prepare Skill Improvements
use_cases.description: Generate evidence-linked draft edits and review diffs before changing live skill files.

prompt_templates.title: Grade This Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Grade recent conversations in this repository. Evaluate project and global skills, then show the report and proposed changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Selected Projects
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze conversations from these project paths: [paths]. Use the last [days] days and sample at most [count] sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Project Skills Only
prompt_templates.prompt: Grade conversations for [project]. Evaluate project skills only, exclude subagents, and explain every recommendation with failed-session evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Cross-Harness Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze all local conversations across supported harnesses. Include subagents, compare recurring failures, and draft only improvements supported by repeated evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across local agent systems

output_examples.input: Grade conversations in this repository from the last 30 days.
output_examples.output: Overall grade: B. The report highlights repeated verification delays, weak skill coverage, and one recurring code-quality defect.

output_examples.input: Evaluate project skills only and draft justified improvements.
output: One description change is proposed from two failed sessions.
No installed skill files were modified.

output_examples.input: Review all supported local conversation sources.
output_examples.output: A combined local report summarizes sampled sessions, skill usage, scorer results, proposed edits, and a shareable image.

best_practices: Choose the smallest conversation scope that answers the audit question.
Review transcript artifacts for sensitive data before sharing any report.
Apply proposed skill edits only after checking their cited session evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a small sample as a complete performance history.
Do not upload collected transcripts to external services.
Do not apply generic skill changes without failed-conversation evidence.

faq.question: Which agent systems are supported?
faq.answer: The collector supports Warp, Claude Code, and Codex local conversation stores.

faq.question: Does the skill upload conversations?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts process conversations locally and create local report artifacts.

faq.question: Will it modify installed skills?
faq.answer: No. It writes proposed versions and diffs into the report directory for review.

faq.question: How are conversations selected?
faq.answer: You choose project or all-conversation scope, skill scope, date window, sample size, and optional subagents.

faq.question: How is code quality handled without code changes?
faq.answer: The scorer records insufficient evidence and excludes that session from the code-quality average.

faq.question: What should I review before sharing a report?
faq.answer: Check findings, proposed diffs, links, and local artifacts for confidential project or conversation data.
